items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 74:1
items.html: For the filling of Alephin is the phase of ZA, and the filling of Heyin is the phase of the Nukva; and since the phase of the Ibur [impregnation] is only from the level of NHY, which is the level of Malchut, therefore the MAN are the phase of the filling of Heyin. (Page 929, Item 110).
